model.name: R19.78: Action buttons render ABOVE the filename, not below.
model.description: The ContentPreviewer action buttons (e.g. 'Open in preview' / 'Open in new tab' per R19.77) MUST render ABOVE the filename/name label, not below it. Layout order top-to-bottom: drawer nudge → action buttons → filename → preview content.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "add the action buttons above the name."
